set.name: forge_mod
set.description: A small fictional NeoForge 1.21.1 mod (examples/forge_mod), shaped differently from glow_mod: Java and Kotlin code (DeferredRegister registries, a forge block with a ticking block entity, a menu and its Kotlin screen, a custom emberforge:forging recipe type and serializer, a client-to-server payload, a ModConfigSpec common config, @SubscribeEvent handlers, Kotlin commands), a data pack (forging/smelting/crafting recipes, item/block/biome tags, loot tables, a configured + placed ore feature, a NeoForge biome modifier, an advancement, two functions), assets (blockstates, block/item models, en_us / tr_tr translations), a documented default config/emberforge-common.toml and JUnit tests; no reference tree. 14 questions, 7 Turkish and 7 English: callers x3, cross_layer x4, config x2, resources x2, flow, behaviour, where.
set.gold_verified_by: Gold facts were written by reading every file of examples/forge_mod line by line; every source.at line was re-read by hand after the example was finished, and each fact's source.at/source.contains pair is re-checked against the benchmark copy before any approach is scored (metrics.validate_gold).

provenance.questions_written_by: an agent asked by the Verinoda maintainer to write examples/forge_mod and this set in one session; it never ran Verinoda on the example and saw no Verinoda output for it or for these questions
provenance.gold_written_by: same agent, by reading every file of examples/forge_mod; checked with metrics.validate_gold only
provenance.example_written_by: same agent, same session, before the questions; written fresh after examples/glow_mod had been used for tuning, with a different loader (NeoForge), language mix (Java + Kotlin) and data shape (worldgen, biome modifier, custom recipe type)
provenance.caveat: held out for Verinoda's retrieval on these questions (no Verinoda run and no Verinoda output while writing the example or the set), but not independent of the design: the Minecraft support (resource ids, data-pack linking, Java calls, Turkish questions) was developed against other mods by the same project (a private mod and examples/glow_mod), and the author knew which kinds of features Verinoda supports when choosing what the example and the questions exercise

verinoda_analyze.budget: config defaults (60 s, 40 tool calls, 6000 tokens)
